language.intro: Choose how you want to read Sahayo. The whole app changes straight away, and your choice is remembered the next time you open it.
language.note: Prices stay in Latin digits in both languages, the way every payment app in India shows them.

coopFund.a: Five percent of every booking goes into a fund owned collectively by the workers of the cooperative, not by the platform. It pays for tools, insurance and lean months. It costs you nothing extra — it comes out of the platform's share, not your bill.

workerShare.q: How much does the worker actually keep?
workerShare.a: Ninety percent of the item price. Five percent is the platform fee and five percent is the community fund. GST is collected on top and remitted to the government; it is never ours to split.

cancel.a: Yes, up until a worker sets off. Once someone is on the way, cancelling may carry the visit charge, because they have already spent the trip.

payment.a: UPI, card, the Sahayo cooperative wallet, or cash once the job is done. Choosing cash means nothing is charged when you book — you settle from the tracking screen after the work is finished.

reschedule.q: Can I move a scheduled booking?
reschedule.a: Yes. Open the booking from the Bookings tab and pick a new slot. Slots already taken by other customers are shown struck through.

verified.a: Every worker on Sahayo is a member of a registered cooperative and has passed KYC. Their rating and completed job count are shown before you book and again while you track.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Sahayo is built by a cooperative, and this policy is written to be read rather than to be survived. It describes what this demo build actually does.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Your name and phone number, the addresses you save, and the bookings you make. In this demo build all of it stays on your phone — there is no server to send it to.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: To match you with a nearby worker, to show you your bookings, and to settle payments. We do not build advertising profiles and we do not sell anything about you.

share.title: Who else sees it
share.body: The worker who accepts your booking sees your first name, your address and your phone number, because they have to reach your door. Nobody else on the platform sees your address.

location.title: Location
location.body: The customer app never asks for background location. It uses your service address to find nearby workers, and that address is one you typed rather than one we tracked.

store.title: How long we keep it
store.body: Booking records are kept while your account exists so you have a history to look back on. Deleting your account removes them, apart from what tax law requires us to retain.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can see, correct or delete anything we hold about you. Ask through the Support tab and a person from the cooperative will handle it.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.intro: These terms cover using Sahayo to book work from members of a registered cooperative.

service.title: What Sahayo is
service.body: Sahayo connects you with skilled workers who are members of a cooperative. The work is done by that worker; Sahayo arranges the introduction, holds the price, and settles the payment.

cooperative.title: The cooperative model
cooperative.body: Workers are members, not gig contractors on a rate card. Ninety percent of the item price reaches the worker, five percent is the platform fee, and five percent goes to a fund the members own collectively.

pricing.title: Prices and tax
pricing.body: Prices are shown before you book and are exclusive of GST, which is added at checkout and remitted to the government. Fault and workshop jobs quote a visit or intake charge; the repair itself is priced after someone has looked at it.

cancellation.title: Cancelling
cancellation.body: Cancel free of charge until a worker sets off. After that the visit charge may apply, because the worker has already made the trip.

conduct.title: How we expect people to behave
conduct.body: Workers arrive on time, in uniform, with their own tools. Customers provide safe access to the work and pay what was agreed. Abuse of a worker ends the booking and the account.

liability.title: If something goes wrong
liability.body: Raise it through the Support tab within seven days. Disputes are reviewed by the cooperative, and the community fund is what backs any settlement — which is part of why it exists.
